identity.title: / 2021-03-00, "Condition Prohibited by Technical Specifications due to failure to perform Breaker Functional Test

cause.proximate_text: This event was caused by a gap in human performance. Senior Reactor Operators (SRO) failed to ensure completion of the required functional test due to perceived time pressure. The SRO authorizing the tagout assumed the breaker functional would be added to the Limiting Condition of Operability (LCO) when the tagout was removed. The SRO authorizing the tagout for removal assumed the breaker functional was added to the LCO already. Neither SRO validated their assumptions.
cause.theme: unvalidated handoff assumptions between SROs on LCO tracking

nodes.display_name: Required breaker functional test not performed after tagout restoration
nodes.description: A required breaker functional test, which would have verified HVK-CHL1D operability, had not been performed when the supply breaker was racked to connect position following tagout restoration.

notes: Block-13 fields in source form are garbled/illegal placeholder characters ('I', '-', 'l', '--') rather than real coded values; copied verbatim per instructions but not used to populate cause_code/category, which remain TBD/provisional per FORM-366 cause_code. Narrative explicitly states 'PREVIOUS SIMILAR EVENTS: None' so no stub LER/SIMILAR_TO edge is created. Breaker is explicitly described as the chiller's supply breaker (racked to connect position for HVK-CHL1D) — modeled as PART_OF the chiller component per explicit-only PART_OF rule, though this is a borderline case (breaker feeding/supplying vs. containment); retained because narrative closely associates it as the chiller's own supply breaker component test scope.
